invariants.propertyAndBoundary: At quiescence, admitted entries equal removed plus retained entries. Multiplicity and payload/priority pairs must match. Clear effects require separate accounting.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Unique IDs, ties, and duplicate payload values. Independent multiset of successful effects.
limitations: Contract review and persisted replay integration pending; Q5 schedules control operation order, not internal instructions.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: At capacity, admission fails without state changes. Sequential Clear restores fresh capacity.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Capacities 1, 2, 3 and powers of two ±1. Reject/remove/refill cycles. Model of admission decisions and full snapshots.
limitations: Contract review and persisted replay integration pending; Q5 schedules control operation order, not internal instructions.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: At quiescence, best-observed removal returns a minimum under the effective comparer. Ties do not require stable payload order.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Lawful custom comparers, reference/value priorities, and representable extremes. Independent ordered multiset.
limitations: Contract review and persisted replay integration pending; Q5 schedules control operation order, not internal instructions.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Recovery from comparer failures preserves coherent contents, counts, and future operations as the contract requires.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Exceptions at each reachable comparison across heap/buffer shapes. Before/after snapshots and a recovery suffix.
limitations: Contract review and persisted replay integration pending; Q5 schedules control operation order, not internal instructions.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Concurrent publication produces no invented or duplicate successful removals. False results obey observed-empty semantics.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Small actor counts, sparse/last-item states, and publication barriers. Permitted-history checks and final conservation.
limitations: Contract review and persisted replay integration pending; Q5 schedules control operation order, not internal instructions.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Consistent transformations of physical times and timestamp units preserve priority-key ordering.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Fake timestamp frequencies. Exact rational conversion with explicit rounding and overflow domain.
limitations: Independent review and replay integration pending; exact representable priority units only; cooldown follow-up not yet integrated.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: With monotone class thresholds, a more urgent class does not face earlier rejection at the same occupancy.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Threshold−1/threshold/threshold+1. Small capacities and fractional watermarks. Independent decision table.
limitations: Independent review and replay integration pending; exact representable priority units only; cooldown follow-up not yet integrated.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Close, drain-wait cancellation, abort, and disposal preserve their distinct lifecycle effects.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Gated handlers and admission/Complete/Drain/Abort/Dispose histories. Explicit lifecycle model.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Counts distinguish work, admission calls, attempts, worker exits, and handler outcomes.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Scripted handlers and observers. Event ledger per identity. Only contract-defined outcome transitions.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Admission retry count, cancellation, and timeout obey the policy. The model does not assume exactly-once admission.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Fail N times, then accept. N around the retry budget. Failures before and after effects. Actual inner-call count.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: At quiescence, written DLQ entries equal read plus retained plus dropped entries.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Capacity-one DropOldest model. Concurrent writes/reads, early drain termination, and cancellation.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Interval progress and phase match the arithmetic model within the declared time domain.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Tick-exact arithmetic. Null/earlier/equal/future last-fire states, tiny intervals, and representable boundaries.
limitations: Independent review pending; generated arithmetic excludes jitter and unrepresentable dates; generic Coalesce is O(backlog).

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Coalesce selects the newest due occurrence. FireAll returns its capped backlog. Skip returns none.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Backlogs K−1/K/K+1 and much larger. Independent due sequence and phase-extension relation.
limitations: Independent review pending; generated arithmetic excludes jitter and unrepresentable dates; generic Coalesce is O(backlog).

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Registry/store changes agree at the documented commit boundary. Stale generations cannot overwrite replacements.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Register/update/pause/resume/unregister histories. Store failures before and after effects. Same-name races. Independent model of committed state.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Restart replay preserves occurrence identity. The model does not assume exactly-once delivery.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Durable fake store. Crashes before and after dispatch and checkpoint. A `(job, scheduled time)` ledger separate from attempts.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Autoscaling decisions obey effective limits and exact watermark/cooldown rules.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Independent decision table. Threshold equality and adjacent values. Minimum/maximum/step partitions.
limitations: Independent review and replay integration pending; exact representable priority units only; cooldown follow-up not yet integrated.

invariants.propertyAndBoundary: Scaling callbacks and Stop/Dispose obey documented overlap and completion guarantees.
invariants.domainAndOracle: Gated coordinator tasks and a controllable timer. Callback-start/stop races and recovery after failed actions.
